label: Conspiracy that was TRUE
titel: The Plot to Overthrow a President

szenen.text: This sounds like fiction. But a general *testified* under oath about it.
It was 1933. America was deep in the *Great Depression.*
Retired Marine General Smedley Butler said wealthy men approached him.
Their alleged goal: overthrow President Roosevelt and install a *dictator.*
A financier named Gerald MacGuire made the approach, Butler said.
In 1934, a House committee heard secret *testimony* in New York.
It found Butler credible. The New York Times called it a *hoax.*
No one was ever *prosecuted.* The case was never tested in court.
Real plot or exaggeration? Follow, and tell me *what you think.*
